subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request — GPU family swap + capacity hold
messages:
From: Sara Liang <sara@aperihealth.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@aperihealth.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask — urgent: H100s, overage cap, and short reservation hold

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We scoped the pilot and have an accelerated rollout plan: we need a temporary dedicated pool that uses H100-class instances (our fine-tuning and validation workloads require the H100 memory/mesh) for approximately 6 weeks starting April 11.

As part of the ask, can Redwood: 
- allow a temporary GPU-family swap from the A100 reservation we currently have to H100-class (same slot count),
- grant a one-time reservation hold through May 31 to ensure capacity during our pilot, and
- cap overage charges at $3.50/hour per GPU during the pilot (we want predictable unit economics while we ramp).

We can sign an amended SOW quickly. I attached the statement of work and a short capacity plan. Also flagging procurement (procurement@aperihealth.com) to align on billing cadence.

We appreciate any expedited review — this pilot unlocks a broader deployment for the rest of 2027.

Best,
Sara
Sara Liang
Head of ML Ops, AperiHealth
Attachment: Aperi_Statement_of_Work_v3.pdf (PDF, 180KB)
Attachment: capacity_plan_q2.xlsx (XLSX, 72KB)

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity ask — urgent: H100s, overage cap, and short reservation hold

Looping you in — AperiHealth is asking for a short-term GPU family swap to H100, a reservation hold through 2027-05-31, and an overage cap of $3.50/hr/GPU for ~6 weeks. They say the pilot starts April 11.

Key constraints:
- We have A100 reservations in the region that can potentially be remapped but this will impact other customers if not handled with a hold.
- Pricing: H100 is materially higher; their requested overage cap is below our standard temporary rate.
- SLA/commitment: they will sign an amended SOW and commit to 6 weeks.

Requesting quick guidance: what approvals do we need for a temporary SKU swap and an overage cap below published burst rates? Also need to confirm whether we can place a soft reservation hold without violating capacity commitments.

Attachment: model_eval_summary.png (PNG, 240KB)

—David

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: david_kim@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity ask — urgent: H100s, overage cap, and short reservation hold

Thanks David — I reviewed Aperi's SOW and the internal utilization projections. High level: I support a constrained exception for this pilot provided we bake in mitigations. Proposed executive conditions: 

1) Timebox the swap: H100 allocation approved only for 2027-04-11 through 2027-05-31. After that the reservation reverts to original SKU unless they sign an extended commitment.
2) Add a 20% uplift on their requested overage cap to account for market delta (effective cap = $4.20/hr/GPU). That still gives them predictability and protects us.
3) Put a reservation hold that is labeled "pilot-priority" — this does not consume committed capacity for more than 6 weeks and has automatic release triggers (no manual ops escalation).
4) Require a signed amendment to SOW and a prepayment equal to 2 weeks of expected usage to secure the hold.

If the team is comfortable with those constraints I authorize us to offer the exception. Marissa, Vivek — can you confirm infra feasibility and billing mechanics?

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity ask — urgent: H100s, overage cap, and short reservation hold

We can support the timeboxed swap and implement an automated reservation label with release triggers. A few implementation notes: 

- Capacity mapping: we will remap their A100 slots to H100 pool for the 6-week window; this requires a migration window of ~3 hours. We'll schedule it overnight for minimal disruption.
- Overage handling: billing can enforce a temporary rate table and the 20% uplift as a capped surcharge. We will surface tokenized usage on the invoice with an explicit line item for the "pilot uplift".
- Prepayment: finance can accept a prepayment and apply it against invoices; need procurement billing contact to issue a PO.

Vivek, confirm that this won't exceed our regional H100 spare capacity if we also honor other pipeline holds next month.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Delivery Lead, Dedicated Capacity

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: david_kim@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity ask — urgent: H100s, overage cap, and short reservation hold

Confirmed — regional H100 spare capacity is marginal but sufficient to honor Aperi's request for a single 6-week pilot if we accept the following constraints:

- The migration window must be scheduled for 2027-04-10 02:00–05:00 PT and the team must accept a single maintenance window.
- We limit the pilot to the exact slot-count in their current reservation (no incremental GPUs during the pilot).
- The overage cap will be enforced at $4.20/hr/GPU (20% uplift over requested cap) and will appear as a capped surcharge.

With Lauren's approval and a signed amendment + 2-week prepayment, I approve operational execution. David — please confirm to Aperi and start the SOW amendment + DocuSign flow.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Infrastructure Operations

From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: Sara Liang <sara@aperihealth.com>, procurement@aperihealth.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — urgent: H100s, overage cap, and short reservation hold

Sara — good news: we have an approved, timeboxed exception for your pilot with the following terms (exec-approved):

1) GPU-family swap: your existing A100 reservation will be remapped to H100-class for 2027-04-11 through 2027-05-31. The migration will occur during an overnight window on 2027-04-10 02:00–05:00 PT.
2) Reservation hold: a labeled "pilot-priority" hold will be placed and automatically released on 2027-05-31.
3) Overage cap: we will cap overage charges at $4.20/hr/GPU (this is a one-time uplift over your requested cap).
4) Financials: Redwood requires a signed SOW amendment and a prepayment equal to two weeks of expected usage to secure the hold and schedule the migration.

Next steps: I attached the amended SOW draft and a link to a DocuSign envelope. If procurement sends a PO referencing deal RWI-D-2027-047 we can lock the hold and schedule the migration window.

Thanks for working with us on a compressed timeline — looking forward to a successful pilot.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
